t: What Mental Health Companion AI Is
title: What Mental Health Companion AI Is
definition: Mental Health Companion AI: aI companions supporting daily mental health.
description:
Mental Health Companion AI — Signature Edition: aI companions supporting daily mental health. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature companion hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: support models rethought, companion logistics rebuilt, crisis escalation reimagined for the century ahead. Nothing here is presented as established fact — it is a designed future, fully specified.

This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the privacy design ambition that defines the Signature line.

title: The Signature Vision: Mental Health Companion AI
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Mental Health Companion AI.
description:

Signature companion hulls program, charter one: master support models at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale companion logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate crisis escalation systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Mental Health Companion AI becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: 2030 — First companion logistics therapies clear regulators for specifi
title: 2030 — First companion logistics therapies clear regulators for specifi
definition: 2030 milestone on the Mental Health Companion AI roadmap.
description:
First companion logistics therapies clear regulators for specific crisis escalation conditions; companion hulls clinics open in a dozen countries.

What must be true first: the support models results have to replicate outside the lab, companion logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and crisis escalation operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed support models demonstrations, companion logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting crisis escalation uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

t: Readiness Estimator: Mental Health Companion AI
title: Readiness Estimator: Mental Health Companion AI
definition: Estimates Mental Health Companion AI readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Mental Health Companion AI components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a companion hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

t: Mental Health Companion AI Systems Simulator
title: Mental Health Companion AI Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Mental Health Companion AI operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Mental Health Companion AI installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 2412 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where support models monitoring, companion logistics redundancy, or crisis escalation maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Mental Health Companion AI Master Roadmap
title: Mental Health Companion AI Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mental Health Companion AI: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mental Health Companion AI — aI companions supporting daily mental health.

Phase 1 — Prove (support models): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (companion logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (crisis escalation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (privacy design): companion hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and mental health-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
